summary: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution on May 12, 2026 to pay a Q1 2026 cash dividend of KRW 2,000 per share (0.4% yield), with a record date of May 27, 2026 and payment on June 12, 2026. Total cash dividend is KRW 151.2 billion. The filing references a shareholder return target of 35-40% of adjusted net income attributable to controlling interests, assessed annually. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration under a pre-existing return policy, not an extraordinary capital return event. What to watch: future dividend consistency relative to earnings and policy commitment.
